name: VR Fileshare
summary: This app provides a fast and convenient way to transfer 360 photos and 3D objects from your PC to your Meta Quest. Simply upload your files to our server at www.vrfileshare.com, and you’ll receive a unique short ID code. Enter this code in the app to instantly access, visualize, and interact with your VR content. For security and efficiency, files are stored on the server for only 15 minutes, giving you ample time to download them. Please note that this method is designed for quick, non-sensitive transfers
